questions.stem_text: Berkeley insists that heat and cold are _____.

options.A: elements of nature that do not exist independently
options.B: only things existing apart from our minds
options.C: only sensations existing in our minds

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - only sensations existing in our minds

questions.stem_text: One suggestion that Lukianoff and Haidt make to challenge vindictive protectiveness is

options.A: to implement stricter guidelines for classroom discussions.
options.B: to promote greater understanding of historical and contemporary oppression.
options.C: to increase the number of safe spaces on campus.
options.D: to mandate sensitivity training for all students.
options.E: to increase funding for mental health services on campus.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - to implement stricter guidelines for classroom discussions.

questions.stem_text: According to Lukianoff and Haidt, the recent trend to uncover microaggressions encourages

options.B: the pursuit of justice by marking out racism, sexism, and classism.
options.C: labeling, by assigning global negative traits to persons.
options.D: universities to bear overly burdensome legal obligations.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - labeling, by assigning global negative traits to persons.

questions.stem_text: In a hypothetical syllogism, when the minor premise affirms the antecedent

options.A: no valid conclusion can be drawn
options.B: the conclusion must affirm the consequent
options.C: the conclusion must deny the consequent
options.D: the conclusion must deny the antecedent

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - the conclusion must affirm the consequent

questions.stem_text: According to Mill, the value of a particular pleasure depends on

options.D: the amount of effort required to obtain it.
options.E: the potential pain that might accompany it.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - its rarity or frequency.
